findings.description: Regions 2, 4, 6, 8 (activity-map dark/light desk & mob) — M5 honesty: LAST 72 HOURS x-axis 'now' contradicts the card's own 'observed Nov 24 · 09:00 JST' header and the listed recent events ('11/24 02:46 JST', ~6h before observed). All 29 events are clustered between -72h and ~-42h while -42h to 'now' is completely empty, indicating the plot is anchored to live wall-clock time rather than the snapshot observation time and falsely depicts ~36 unobserved hours as zero activity.

Regions 2, 4, 6, 8 (activity-map dark/light desk & mob) — M5 encoding accuracy: In REPO OUTPUT · 30D, the aggregated '+22 more public' row on desktop (101p) and '+24 more public' row on mobile (211p) render 4 purple PR squares — the maximum tier matching FlashBeat (572p) and private repos · sum (548p), and exceeding my-web-2026 (352p, which renders only 3 squares). The PR square scale breaks monotonicity for the aggregate row.

Regions 5, 7 (identity dark/light mob) — M4 hierarchy & M5 labels match encodings: The bottom-right footer renders the tier legend '■■■ primary  ■■ active  ■ side', but the 4 IN PROGRESS rows use uniform icon sizes and omit the pip indicators entirely, leaving an orphaned legend and losing the primary/active/side focus hierarchy present on desktop.

Regions 5, 7 (identity dark/light mob) — M3 glanceability: The CONTRIBUTED TO card omits the total repo count (desktop shows 'CONTRIBUTED TO · 28 REPOS', mobile shows only 'CONTRIBUTED TO' with a 9x3 dot grid and '+1'), forcing readers to count dots to get 28 and making '+1' ambiguous at a glance.

Regions 2, 4 (activity-map dark/light desk) — M2/M5 visual consistency: The '+22 more public' row (152c) renders 3 tiny faint ellipsis-like dots in the commits track (barely legible on dark mode) instead of encoded commit dots, inconsistent with 'private repos · sum' directly below it, the mobile '+24 more public' proportional bar, and individual rows with fewer commits (101c–149c, 2 blue dots each).

verdict.summary: Desktop identity bands (Regions 1, 3) are clean, honest, and visually well-structured across dark and light themes, but three major M4/M5 defects block approval: (1) the activity-map LAST 72 HOURS chart anchors 'now' to live time rather than 'observed Nov 24 · 09:00 JST', contradicting the listed 11/24 02:46 JST events and showing ~36 unobserved hours as empty; (2) the '+22/+24 more public' aggregate row renders 4 PR squares despite having far fewer PRs (101p/211p) than my-web-2026 (352p, 3 squares); and (3) mobile identity cards print the 'primary/active/side' pip legend without rendering any tier pips or size hierarchy on the focus rows.
